sources.games: 360 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 49.4%, hard support (STRATZ pos5, 4452 games). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py dazzle.
sources.items: No item rule: the only candidate rows (Ghost Scepter against break heroes and jumpers) have no mechanic behind them and win less; build from the games.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 98% (1), magic_wand 98% (7), ring_of_basilius 70% (10), arcane_boots 67% (13), holy_locket 78% (19), headdress 33% (21), mekansm 28% (24), great_famango 24% (26), glimmer_cape 28% (27), blink 55% (31). Reviewed: the draft as is. STRATZ pos5 (4452 games) has only Holy Locket at 18 min (72%, won 56%); Mekansm (28% at 24 min) and Blink Dagger (55% at 31 min) come from the league games only (asked).

skills.basis: 360 games since 7.41: maxed dazzle_shadow_wave > dazzle_shallow_grave > dazzle_poison_touch 191 (win 57.6%), dazzle_poison_touch > dazzle_shadow_wave > dazzle_shallow_grave 51 (win 66.7%), dazzle_shadow_wave > dazzle_shallow_grave 34 (win 23.5%); talents 10: +1.75 Mana Regen 177/351 (51.4%), +200 Poison Touch Attack Range 174/351 (50.0%); 15: +45 Shadow Wave Heal / Damage 220/259 (60.0%), special_bonus_unique_dazzle_nothl_projection_duration 39/259 (56.4%); 20: -3s Shallow Grave Cooldown 93/97 (69.9%), +75 Poison Touch DPS 4/97 (75.0%); 25: +1 Weave Armor Reduction/Increase 13/19 (76.9%), +40% Poison Touch Slow 6/19 (100.0%).
